description: NaErS₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ErS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent ErS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 5°. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.90 Å. Er³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form ErS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent ErS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 5°. All Er-S bond lengths are 2.72 Å. S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Er³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Er₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
